name: protocolos-notariais-server
description: Servidor unico dos Protocolos Notariais com SQLite e sincronizacao em tempo real.

scripts.build:mac: pkg . --targets node22-macos-arm64 --options no-warnings --public --public-packages "*" --output dist/Protocolos-Notariais && node scripts/stage-distribution.js mac
scripts.build:win: pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --options no-warnings --public --public-packages "*" --output dist/Protocolos-Notariais.exe && node scripts/stage-distribution.js win
